explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The lemma is a commutation square of morphisms in `TopModuleCat`, and every map in it is one of the library's own definitions: `crossedTrans`, `crossedQuotientTrans`, `principalCocycles`, `TopRep.res` and `OpenSubgroup.trans`. The proof is just `ext f; rfl`, so all of the content comes from how these definitions unfold. Mathlib has no continuous group cohomology of topological representations from which this could be obtained. I did not run a dedicated search, because a statement built entirely on the library's own definitions cannot be a Mathlib result.
